title: ZS and The Birthday Paradox
statementMd:
ZS the Coder has recently found an interesting concept called the Birthday Paradox. It states that given a random set of $23$ people, there is around $50%$ chance that some two of them share the same birthday. ZS the Coder finds this very interesting, and decides to test this with the inhabitants of Udayland.

In Udayland, there are $2^{*n*}$ days in a year. ZS the Coder wants to interview $*k*$ people from Udayland, each of them has birthday in one of $2^{*n*}$ days (each day with equal probability). He is interested in the probability of at least two of them have the birthday at the same day.

ZS the Coder knows that the answer can be written as an irreducible fraction ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/930727af0e5a75c815d4282e2e454bf5e3fae083.png). He wants to find the values of $*A*$ and $*B*$ (he does not like to deal with floating point numbers). Can you help him?

## Input

The first and only line of the input contains two integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{18}, 2 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{18})$, meaning that there are $2^{*n*}$ days in a year and that ZS the Coder wants to interview exactly $*k*$ people.

## Output

If the probability of at least two $*k*$ people having the same birthday in $2^{*n*}$ days long year equals ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/930727af0e5a75c815d4282e2e454bf5e3fae083.png) ($*A* ≥ 0$, $*B* ≥ 1$, ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/47ae85b047b70a12975d0f4e001f9796b29a6e67.png)), print the $*A*$ and $*B*$ in a single line.

Since these numbers may be too large, print them modulo $10^{6} + 3$. Note that $*A*$ and $*B*$ must be coprime **before** their remainders modulo $10^{6} + 3$ are taken.

## Note

In the first sample case, there are $2^{3} = 8$ days in Udayland. The probability that $2$ people have the same birthday among $2$ people is clearly ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5947a169159fe867f85f3fd8b9690019b48152f5.png), so $*A* = 1$, $*B* = 8$.

In the second sample case, there are only $2^{1} = 2$ days in Udayland, but there are $3$ people, so it is guaranteed that two of them have the same birthday. Thus, the probability is $1$ and $*A* = *B* = 1$.
statementZhMd:
ZS the Coder 最近发现了一个有趣的概念，叫作生日悖论。它指出，给定一个随机的 $23$ 人集合，其中至少有两个人生日相同的概率约为 $50%$。ZS the Coder 对此非常感兴趣，于是决定在 Udayland 的居民中进行测试。

在 Udayland，一年有 $2^{*n*}$ 天。ZS the Coder 想要采访来自 Udayland 的 $*k*$ 个人，他们每个人的生日都是 $2^{*n*}$ 天中的某一天（每一天被选中的概率相等）。他想知道其中至少有两个人在同一天过生日的概率。

ZS the Coder 知道答案可以表示为一个既约分数 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/930727af0e5a75c815d4282e2e454bf5e3fae083.png)。他想求出 $*A*$ 和 $*B*$ 的值（他不喜欢处理浮点数）。你能帮助他吗？

## 输入格式

输入仅一行，包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{18}, 2 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{18})$，分别表示一年有 $2^{*n*}$ 天，以及 ZS the Coder 想要采访恰好 $*k*$ 个人。

## 输出格式

如果在一年有 $2^{*n*}$ 天的情况下，$*k*$ 个人中至少有两个人生日相同的概率等于 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/930727af0e5a75c815d4282e2e454bf5e3fae083.png)（$*A* ≥ 0$，$*B* ≥ 1$，![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/47ae85b047b70a12975d0f4e001f9796b29a6e67.png)），请在一行中输出 $*A*$ 和 $*B*$。

由于这些数可能非常大，请将它们对 $10^{6} + 3$ 取模后输出。注意，在对 $10^{6} + 3$ 取模之前，$*A*$ 和 $*B*$ 必须互质。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，Udayland 一年有 $2^{3} = 8$ 天。显然，$2$ 个人中至少有两个人生日相同的概率为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5947a169159fe867f85f3fd8b9690019b48152f5.png)，因此 $*A* = 1$，$*B* = 8$。

在第二个样例中，Udayland 一年只有 $2^{1} = 2$ 天，但有 $3$ 个人，因此一定有两个人生日相同。所以概率为 $1$，且 $*A* = *B* = 1$。
